_comment: Copy to env.local.json (GITIGNORED) and fill in for THIS machine. Scripts refuse to run without env.local.json. 'env' selects the environment. On a machine WITH the global sp-env skill (dev), tenants.local.json is authoritative — omit siteUrl/roots/mirrors here (any value that disagrees with it is an error, not an override). On a machine WITHOUT the global skill (prod), siteUrl and roots are REQUIRED here.
